response.text:
Drop slide 6 (Architecture) and slide 7 (Security).

Why: both are deep technical dives that eat time and commonly aren’t needed in a first 10‑minute pitch. Keeping problem, approach, market, pricing, case study/traction, team and the ask preserves the narrative investors care about (why it matters, how you win, market size, validation, and what you want). Architecture and security are valuable backup material for a follow‑up or appendix when technical due diligence happens, so you can answer questions without using precious pitch time.

If your audience is highly technical or security‑sensitive (enterprise/infosec buyers), instead consider dropping the case study and the roadmap so you can keep architecture and security.
